text: Implemented in f1fc13d: typed rank-q contrast preparation; Gale generalized-root spectra through FunctionalFrame and OperatorProgramFit; Roy, Wilks, Pillai, and Hotelling-Lawley estimands; frozen-frame held-out evaluation; repeated-root projectors; independent base-R fixtures and generator.
